en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Suleyman Bin Rusheyd, from his father, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘The one who recites the Quran so he is rich, and there is no poverty after it, or else he is not with riches’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Sulayman ibn Rashid from his father from Mu’awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) once said to me, ‘If anyone reads the Holy Quran, he is wealthy and there is no poverty thereafter, otherwise, he will never be wealthy.’”
